title: Currents given by integrable densities on finitely many faces: existence, mass, boundary mass and support (Simon (29)–(30), (34))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let s be a finite set of index pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing, and for p ∈ s let w_p : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on Q₁ = (0,1)ⁿ. Write Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} and e_ι := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(n−1)}). Then: (I) for every test n-form ω and p ∈ s, y ↦ w_p(y) ω(Φ_p y)(e_ι) is integrable on Q₁; (II) some D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) satisfies D(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p(y) ω(Φ_p y)(e_ι) dy for all ω; (III) every such D satisfies (a) M(D) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_p ∫_{Q₁}|w_p|), (b) M(∂D) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_p B_p) whenever the reals B_p satisfy |∫_{Q₁} w_p · trace(DG)| ≤ B_p for all p ∈ s and all C^∞ G : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with |G| ≤ 1, and (c) every x ∈ spt D equals Φ_p(y) for some p ∈ s with ∫_{Q₁}|w_p| ≠ 0 and some y ∈ [0,1]ⁿ.
